Genres filter

Motionby @proskuaaa2026-08-30inspora pageoriginal post

What it is

iOS dark filters sheet where the Genres row expands in place into a rotary wheel: genre names arranged along a curved arc that spin under the finger, checked genres get blue dots, and the footer button live-updates 'Continue with N'; the wheel collapses back into the row.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-12%
Filters sheet: rows for Location, Dates, Friends attend, Genres (shows 'Afrobeat, Bluegrass +6'), Time, Price; Reset all + primary Continue button.
12-25%
Genres row expands vertically in place (height animates, siblings push down) revealing a wheel: genre labels laid on an arc, rotated tangentially, fading toward edges.
25-60%
Wheel spins: labels rotate through the center window (Afrobeat, Bluegrass, Chant, EDM, Disco, Electronic, Experimental, Folk, Funk, Hip-Hop, House...); tapped labels toggle a blue check dot; selection summary in the row header updates live.
60-85%
Spinning continues with inertia - flick gestures coast and decelerate; center-most label reads crispest, edge labels rotate away and dim.
85-100%
Row collapses back (height -> row, wheel crossfades to the summary text); Continue button shows 'Continue with 4'.

Mechanics

trigger
tap Genres row to expand; drag/flick to spin; tap label to toggle
elements
filter rows, rotary wheel (arc-laid labels), check dots, count-aware CTA
properties
row height, label rotation/position on arc, label opacity by distance from center, check dot pop, CTA label
timing
expand 350ms spring; wheel inertia with friction decel; check pop 150ms
easing
spring expand; cubic decel on flick
loop
expand-spin-collapse cycle

Build prompt

Build a rotary genre picker inside a filter sheet. Dark sheet with standard rows; tapping Genres animates the row's container height (spring, 350ms) to reveal a 220px wheel viewport. Genres are absolutely positioned on a circular arc: each label's angle = index * step + scrollOffset; project with x = R*sin(a), y = R*(1-cos(a)) and rotate the label to the tangent; opacity = cos(a) clamped, blur beyond +-50deg. Drag vertical updates scrollOffset 1:1; on release apply flick velocity with exponential friction (v *= 0.95/frame) and no snapping - free spin. Tap a label to toggle: blue check dot pops in (scale 0->1 spring 150ms) and the row summary + CTA count recompute. Collapse: height springs back, wheel crossfades to the one-line summary. Haptics: light tick each time a label crosses center.
